:::{#def-sigma-algebra}
#### $\sigma$-algebra ($\sigma$-field, Borel field)

A **$\sigma$-algebra**
[@wikipedia_sigma_algebra]
(also called a **$\sigma$-field** [@billingsley1995probability]
or a **Borel field**
[@CaseBerg01, Definition 1.2.1])
on a set $S$
is a [collection](https://morrison-lab.github.io/mcs/sets.html#def-collection) $\salg$ of [subsets](https://morrison-lab.github.io/mcs/sets.html#def-subset) of $S$
that satisfies:

- $\salg$ contains $S$ itself.
- For each set $A$ in $\salg$,
  $\salg$ contains its [complement](https://morrison-lab.github.io/mcs/sets.html#def-complement) $S \setminus A$.
- For each [sequence](https://morrison-lab.github.io/mcs/functions.html#def-sequence) $A_1, A_2, \ldots$ of sets in $\salg$,
  $\salg$ contains their union $\bigcup_{i=1}^{\infty} A_i$.

:::
